articles.title: Mariupol veteran who flew in classified mission on what every Ukrainian should know
articles.summary: "Everyone in Ukraine should know how to apply a tourniquet and how to stop someone's bleeding," Anatolii says.

articles.title: Lula re-elected president in Brazil but his opponent refuses to accept result
articles.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has been re-elected president of Brazil, the electoral authority has said, in a result that defied poll predictions - but his opponent has refused to accept the result.

articles.title: Over 80 injured after bus plunges down Spanish hillside
articles.summary: More than 80 people have been injured, including seven seriously, after a bus plunged off the side of road in Spain.

articles.title: Talks between Ukraine, Russia and US to be held next month
articles.summary: A meeting between Ukraine, Russia and the US will take place next month, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: Exiled opposition leader announces shock return to Venezuela
articles.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado has returned ‌to the country nearly a year after her daring escape.

articles.title: Bus and lorry collide killing 22, including passengers returning from funeral
articles.summary: At least 22 people have been killed after a bus and lorry collided in Kenya, police say.

articles.title: Serbia's pro-Russian leader urges supporters to avoid 'killings' after defeat
articles.summary: Serbia's long-serving pro-Russian leader has urged his supporters to avoid "killings" after he conceded defeat to a student-led movement at the election.

articles.title: Brazilians head to the polls with left-winger and son of Trump ally neck and neck
articles.summary: Brazilians are going to the polls today to elect a president in a run-off vote that is being closely watched around the world.
